title: Lightened Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Grilled chicken over crisp romaine with a yogurt-based Caesar dressing and parmesan.
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Whisk the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, mustard and half the parmesan into a dressing.
Toss the romaine with the dressing, top with chicken, remaining parmesan and croutons.
notes: Greek yogurt replaces most of the oil in a classic Caesar dressing without losing the tang.
